entries.short: Its gills have grown into a crown of crystal drops, and its hood of clear glass chimes softly as it moves.

entries.entry: A gibbon whose belly is a temple bell; it swings by its arms and clangs itself to stun everyone. Loud, joyful, a show-off; sings when happy and louder when scared.
entries.habitat: Wild, on any island of the Skylands.
entries.lore: Its belly is a bronze gong, and it strikes it with its mallet-tipped tail at sunrise every morning, so nobody on the farm ever sleeps late. Gongibbon sings when it is happy and sings even louder when it is scared. Males are dark-furred; females are pale grey and wear a circlet of gold leaves.

entries.short: Its belly is a bronze gong, and it strikes it with its mallet-tipped tail at sunrise every morning, so nobody on the farm ever sleeps late.

entries.lore: Skateron stands motionless at a frozen pond's edge for hours, then strikes exactly once with its ice-pick beak and glides away. It says little, and it seems to approve of people only when they stand very still.
entries.name: Skateron
entries.short: Skateron stands motionless at a frozen pond's edge for hours, then strikes exactly once with its ice-pick beak and glides away.

d.lore: Ice-armoured heron, beak an ice lance, blade feathers.
d.quirk: Its blade feathers hum in wind; a high whine means a gale tonight.

entries.entry: Ice-armoured heron, beak an ice lance, blade feathers.
entries.lore: Armoured in ice, this heron carries a beak as long as a lance. The blade feathers on its wings hum in the wind, and fishing villages listen for a high whine that means a gale is coming tonight.
entries.name: Lanceron
entries.short: Armoured in ice, this heron carries a beak as long as a lance.

d.lore: Stoat whose tail is a calligraphy brush, cream coat like a blank page.
d.quirk: Dips its tail in any ink or mud and scribbles on your walls.

entries.entry: Stoat whose tail is a calligraphy brush, cream coat like a blank page.
entries.lore: Minkee's tail is a soft calligraphy brush, and its cream coat is as blank as a fresh page. It dips the brush in any ink or mud it finds and scribbles on your walls. What its coat becomes depends on what it learns to paint with.
entries.name: Minkee
entries.short: Minkee's tail is a soft calligraphy brush, and its cream coat is as blank as a fresh page.

d.lore: Flame-brush tail, fiery brushstroke coat.
d.quirk: Draws warm strokes on cold mornings; frost melts wherever it writes.

entries.entry: Flame-brush tail, fiery brushstroke coat.
entries.lore: Once Minkee's brush catches fire, its coat fills with fiery strokes and the bristles glow like embers. Embermink paints warm lines on cold mornings, and frost melts wherever it writes.
entries.name: Embermink
entries.short: Once Minkee's brush catches fire, its coat fills with fiery strokes and the bristles glow like embers.

d.lore: Otter-sleek, wave strokes, webbed paws.
d.quirk: Paints wave lines on the shore that show how high the next tide reaches.

entries.entry: Otter-sleek, wave strokes, webbed paws.
entries.lore: Sleek as an otter, with webbed paws and wave strokes rippling down its coat. Rippmink paints lines along the shore that show exactly how high the next tide will reach, and fishermen trust them more than any almanac.
entries.name: Rippmink
entries.short: Sleek as an otter, with webbed paws and wave strokes rippling down its coat.

d.lore: Leaf-bristle brush, painted petals and vines.
d.quirk: Petals it paints bloom real by morning if left on good soil.

entries.entry: Leaf-bristle brush, painted petals and vines.
entries.lore: Its brush has sprouted leaf bristles, and painted petals and vines wind across its fur. Petals Blossmink paints on good soil are real flowers by morning, so gardeners lay out fresh beds for it in spring.
entries.name: Blossmink
entries.short: Its brush has sprouted leaf bristles, and painted petals and vines wind across its fur.

d.lore: Wire-bristle brush, zig-zag lightning strokes.
d.quirk: Its strokes crackle; on dry days its fur stands on end and shocks you.

entries.entry: Wire-bristle brush, zig-zag lightning strokes.
entries.lore: Voltmink's brush is shaped like a lightning bolt, and its strokes crackle as they dry. On dry days its fur stands on end, and anyone who pets it gets a sharp shock for their trouble.
entries.name: Voltmink
entries.short: Voltmink's brush is shaped like a lightning bolt, and its strokes crackle as they dry.

d.lore: Icicle brush, frost-lace strokes, long and sleek.
d.quirk: Paints frost lace on windows at dawn, never the same pattern twice.

entries.entry: Icicle brush, frost-lace strokes, long and sleek.
entries.lore: Long and sleek, with a brush of icicles. At dawn Rimink paints frost lace across window panes, and in all the years islanders have watched, no one has seen it paint the same pattern twice.
entries.name: Rimink
entries.short: Long and sleek, with a brush of icicles.

d.lore: Soaked jet-black, smoking brush.
d.quirk: Its ink never dries; whatever it marks stays smudged for days.

entries.entry: Soaked jet-black, smoking brush.
entries.lore: Nightmink looks permanently soaked in black ink, and its brush trails smoke. The ink never dries, so whatever it touches stays smudged for days, and a dark paw print on the door is how you know it visited.
entries.name: Nightmink
entries.short: Nightmink looks permanently soaked in black ink, and its brush trails smoke.

d.lore: Silver ink, crescent strokes, moth-feather ears.
d.quirk: Only paints under moonlight; by day the silver fades to nothing.

entries.entry: Silver ink, crescent strokes, moth-feather ears.
entries.lore: Moth-feather ears and silver crescent strokes mark this Minkee of the night. Lunink only paints under moonlight, and by morning its silver pictures have faded to nothing, leaving only the people who stayed up to see them.
entries.name: Lunink
entries.short: Moth-feather ears and silver crescent strokes mark this Minkee of the night.

d.lore: Rainbow ink that splits light.
d.quirk: Each stroke splits into a rainbow when the sun hits it.

entries.entry: Rainbow ink that splits light.
entries.lore: Clear crystal plates run down its back and a prism holds its brush, so every stroke Prismink paints breaks into a rainbow when the sun hits it. Children chase it across the yard to stand in the colours it leaves behind.
entries.name: Prismink
entries.short: Clear crystal plates run down its back and a prism holds its brush, so every stroke Prismink paints breaks into a rainbow when the sun hits it.

d.lore: Long, serpentine ink-dragon stoat.
d.quirk: Coils through the air leaving a trailing ink line that fades in seconds.

entries.entry: Long, serpentine ink-dragon stoat.
entries.lore: The longest and rarest of Minkee's forms, a serpentine ink dragon that coils through the air. Wyrmink leaves a trailing line of ink behind it as it flies, and the line fades in seconds, like writing no one was meant to read.
entries.name: Wyrmink
entries.short: The longest and rarest of Minkee's forms, a serpentine ink dragon that coils through the air.

abilities.name: Echo Chain
abilities.text: A sound pulse leaps between up to 3 foes, stunning each 0.4s, then echoes 0.9s later and does it all again at half strength.

abilities.name: Storm Arc
abilities.text: On its own, Kestrike crackles a bolt at the nearest foe that jumps to two more.

abilities.name: Resonance
abilities.text: Kestrike hums over you for 6s: 30% faster, every dash back, and each shot echoes to a second foe.

d.group: Small Boki: grown and final forms
d.lore: A kestrel with a copper crest that draws lightning. It hangs still in the wind, then strikes like the bolt it caught.
d.quirk: Hovers over the same fence post before every storm; the post is your warning.

temper.name: Proud
temper.play: Fast, darting and always on the move.

d.voice: clipped and proud, a little stern

entries.entry: A kestrel with a copper crest that draws lightning. It hangs still in the wind, then strikes like the bolt it caught.
entries.habitat: Wild, on any island of the Skylands.
entries.lore: Kestrike hangs perfectly still in the wind, its crest pointed at the clouds, then strikes like the bolt it caught. Before every storm it hovers over the same fence post, and farmers learn to treat that post as a warning. Males are rust-red with a spiked copper crest; females are peach with a curled teal one.
entries.name: Kestrike
entries.short: Kestrike hangs perfectly still in the wind, its crest pointed at the clouds, then strikes like the bolt it caught.

d.group: Small Boki: grown and final forms
d.lore: Falcon with lightning-rod crest and coil talons.
d.quirk: Perches on the tallest metal thing you own; put up a lightning rod.

entries.entry: Falcon with lightning-rod crest and coil talons.
entries.lore: Lightning rods have grown into its crest, and copper coils wrap its talons. Arcestrel perches on the tallest metal thing on any farm, so sensible keepers put up a proper lightning rod and let it have that instead. Males are rust-red; females are a sandy tan.
entries.name: Arcestrel
entries.short: Lightning rods have grown into its crest, and copper coils wrap its talons.

d.group: Small Boki: grown and final forms
d.lore: Thunder falcon, coil talons, lightning crown.
d.quirk: Lightning strikes twice as often near it, and it treats each bolt as a snack.

entries.entry: Thunder falcon, coil talons, lightning crown.
entries.lore: A crown of lightning crackles around the head of this thunder falcon. Lightning strikes twice as often anywhere near Voltalon, and it snaps up each bolt like a snack. Males are rust-red; females are a sandy tan.
entries.name: Voltalon
entries.short: A crown of lightning crackles around the head of this thunder falcon.

d.group: Small Boki: grown and final forms
d.lore: Badger cub with a tin-cup snout and a hot stripe.
d.quirk: Rattles its tin snout against pots when the stove is too cold.

entries.entry: Badger cub with a tin-cup snout and a hot stripe.
entries.lore: Whenever the stove goes cold, Tinbrock rattles the pots until someone notices. The stripe down this badger cub's back runs hot to the touch, so it is never cold itself.
entries.name: Tinbrock
entries.short: Whenever the stove goes cold, Tinbrock rattles the pots until someone notices.

abilities.name: Gravity Slam
abilities.text: Anvilbrock drops onto the spot like a meteor: everything within 3.5m is sucked into the crater and flung up; anyone already airborne is spiked.

abilities.name: Mass Guard
abilities.text: When you're under fire, Anvilbrock curls into a heavy plate in front of you for 3s that stops enemy shots (120 HP).

abilities.name: Heavy Star
abilities.text: Anvilbrock folds into you as a heavy star for 10s. Slam with the left button, roll through foes with the right, drag them in with E, then Fuse again brings the whole sky down.

d.lore: A honey badger with a red-hot anvil for a back; it headbutts you and the anvil rings. Fearless and grumpy; picks fights it cannot win and wins them.
d.quirk: Lies on its back in snow and the melt puddle gives away where it slept.

temper.name: Fearless
temper.play: Stands in front and soaks the hits.

entries.entry: A honey badger with a red-hot anvil for a back; it headbutts you and the anvil rings. Fearless and grumpy; picks fights it cannot win and wins them.
entries.habitat: Wild, on any island of the Skylands.
entries.lore: Anvilbrock's back is an iron anvil that rings and throws sparks when it headbutts. It picks fights it cannot win and wins them anyway. In winter it sleeps on its back in the snow, and the melt puddle shows exactly where it lay.
entries.name: Anvilbrock
entries.short: Anvilbrock's back is an iron anvil that rings and throws sparks when it headbutts.

d.group: Small Boki: grown and final forms
d.lore: Bigger forge badger, hammer-head paws, furnace chest.
d.quirk: Hammers any metal left outdoors; dented tools mean it was bored.

entries.entry: Bigger forge badger, hammer-head paws, furnace chest.
entries.lore: It rears up like a bear now, with an anvil on its back and a chest that burns like an open furnace. Forgebrock hammers any metal left outdoors, so a shed full of dented tools is a sure sign it got bored overnight.
entries.name: Forgebrock
entries.short: It rears up like a bear now, with an anvil on its back and a chest that burns like an open furnace.

abilities.name: Gale Lance
abilities.text: Kindlewren spears 8m through the air, shocking everything it passes, then bursts in a ring of wind that throws foes back and arcs lightning to two more.

abilities.name: Stinger Dash
abilities.text: On its own, Kindlewren lunges 7m tail first, poisoning everything it passes through.

abilities.name: Stormwing
abilities.text: Kindlewren wraps you in a living storm for 10s. Chaining bolts, a hover over any gap, a double storm blink, and Fuse again calls a thunderhead down on everyone near.

d.lore: A cocky little wren that carries a live coal in its cocked-up tail. It darts in, scorches, and is gone.
d.quirk: Steals a coal from your fire each evening and sulks if there is none.

temper.name: Cheeky
temper.play: Fast, darting and always on the move.

d.voice: cheeky and quick, chirps over everyone

entries.entry: A cocky little wren that carries a live coal in its cocked-up tail. It darts in, scorches, and is gone.
entries.habitat: Wild, on any island of the Skylands.
entries.lore: This cocky little wren carries a live coal in its cocked-up tail. Kindlewren darts in, scorches, and is gone. Each evening it steals a coal from the nearest fire and sulks if no one has lit one.
entries.name: Kindlewren
entries.short: This cocky little wren carries a live coal in its cocked-up tail.

d.lore: Rook with a coal-bed back and cinder wings.
d.quirk: Sleeps in dead hearths; your fire relights itself if one roosts there.

entries.entry: Rook with a coal-bed back and cinder wings.
entries.lore: A rook whose back is a bed of glowing coals, with cinder wings that crackle when folded. Embrook sleeps in dead hearths, and a fire that relights itself overnight usually means one roosted there.
entries.name: Embrook
entries.short: A rook whose back is a bed of glowing coals, with cinder wings that crackle when folded.

d.lore: Huge raven with smouldering coal-bed wings.
d.quirk: Its wings glow brighter as the sun sets; a dim one needs feeding.

entries.entry: Huge raven with smouldering coal-bed wings.
entries.lore: Pyrraven's great wings are beds of smouldering coal that glow brighter as the sun goes down. A dim one at dusk is a hungry one, and keepers hurry out with a bucket of charcoal.
entries.name: Pyrraven
entries.short: Pyrraven's great wings are beds of smouldering coal that glow brighter as the sun goes down.

d.group: Big Boki: baby form, then a bigger final
d.lore: Capybara pup, a puddle cupped on its back.
d.quirk: Its back puddle only fills in rain; it stands outside until topped up.

entries.entry: Capybara pup, a puddle cupped on its back.
entries.lore: Rain is the only thing that fills the small puddle cupped on Dribbara's back. So the capybara pup stands outside in every shower, patient and content, until it is topped up.
entries.name: Dribbara
entries.short: Rain is the only thing that fills the small puddle cupped on Dribbara's back.

abilities.name: Prism Wall
abilities.text: Soakybara raises a 4m crystal wall at the spot: enemy shots that hit it bounce back at them. Lasts 4.5s or 140 damage.

abilities.name: Refraction
abilities.text: When you're hurt, Soakybara wraps you in a 1s mirror shell: shots that reach you fly back at the shooter, and you get a 20 shield.

abilities.name: Prism Shell
abilities.text: Soakybara grows a crystal shell around you for 10s. Piercing shards, a prism that throws shots back, a healing crystal wall, and Fuse again shatters the shell outward.

d.lore: A capybara with a hot spring on its back; you ride sitting in the bath, and the steam heals the squad. Calm and sociable, the friend of everything; nothing ruffles it.
d.quirk: Other farm Boki crowd into its spring on cold nights; it never minds.

temper.name: Calm
temper.play: Keeps you alive and patched up.

entries.entry: A capybara with a hot spring on its back; you ride sitting in the bath, and the steam heals the squad. Calm and sociable, the friend of everything; nothing ruffles it.
entries.habitat: Wild, on any island of the Skylands.
entries.lore: Soakybara carries a hot spring on its back, and riders sit right in the bath while the steam heals their friends. Nothing ruffles it. On cold nights the other farm Boki crowd into its spring, and it never minds.
entries.name: Soakybara
entries.short: Soakybara carries a hot spring on its back, and riders sit right in the bath while the steam heals their friends.

d.group: Big Boki: baby form, then a bigger final
d.lore: Massive capybara, erupting geyser pool and moss terraces.
d.quirk: Erupts on a schedule to the minute; farmers set their clocks by it.

entries.entry: Massive capybara, erupting geyser pool and moss terraces.
entries.lore: Moss terraces climb the sides of this massive capybara, and a geyser pool sits on top. Geyserbara erupts on a schedule accurate to the minute, and farmers across the island set their clocks by it.
entries.name: Geyserbara
entries.short: Moss terraces climb the sides of this massive capybara, and a geyser pool sits on top.

abilities.name: Boulder Heave
abilities.text: Buckleron heaves a rune-lit boulder 8m. Where it lands everyone within 2.6m is thrown up and stunned; anyone already airborne is spiked.

abilities.name: Mass Guard

abilities.name: Cairn Colossus
abilities.text: Buckleron rises into a rune-carved colossus under you for 8s: a stone shell takes the hits first, and every stomp quakes the ground and stuns.

d.quirk: Clamps down at sunset and will not budge till sunrise, whatever you offer.

entries.lore: Buckleron is a round toadlet that wears a riveted iron shield over its head like a helmet. It clamps down at sunset and will not budge till sunrise, whatever you offer. As the iron thickens and rusts, it grows into Bulwartoad.
entries.name: Buckleron
entries.short: Buckleron is a round toadlet that wears a riveted iron shield over its head like a helmet.

d.lore: Bulwartoad, art-lane design.

entries.entry: Bulwartoad, art-lane design.
entries.lore: Bulwartoad's shield has grown into a spiked iron dome, rusted and crusted with barnacles. It squats in the path of anything charging at its friends and lets the blow ring off its back. Islanders say the ringing carries right across the valley.
entries.name: Bulwartoad
entries.short: Bulwartoad's shield has grown into a spiked iron dome, rusted and crusted with barnacles.

d.lore: Crabulwark, art-lane design.

entries.entry: Crabulwark, art-lane design.
entries.lore: Crabulwark is a great crab whose broad stone shell is chipped from years of taking hits for others, with coral and seaweed growing in the cracks. It sidles in front of anything smaller and stays there, claws raised, until the danger has gone.
entries.name: Crabulwark
entries.short: Crabulwark is a great crab whose broad stone shell is chipped from years of taking hits for others, with coral and seaweed growing in the cracks.

abilities.text: Lodestick throws a moon mark 9m. The first foe it touches trades places with YOU (stunned 0.4s): pull a rival off a ledge, or step behind them.

abilities.name: Moonlift
abilities.text: On its own, when you fall into the abyss, Lodestick throws up a column of moonlight that lifts you high and cools your glider.

abilities.name: Eclipse
abilities.text: Lodestick swells into a living eclipse for 7s that drags foes in and flings them skyward.

temper.name: Still

entries.lore: Magnestick is a stick insect built from dark lodestone twigs. Loose nails and coins drift toward it overnight, so anyone who loses something small should check it before searching anywhere else.

entries.entry: Evolution of Magnestick.
entries.lore: Grown tall and sharp-edged, Magnestaff walks inside a slow ring of floating stones and scrap. It speaks rarely, with long pauses, and everything metal in a room leans a little toward it while it thinks.
entries.name: Magnestaff
entries.short: Grown tall and sharp-edged, Magnestaff walks inside a slow ring of floating stones and scrap.

abilities.text: Marchleaf looses a buzzing swarm in a 5m cone: stung, poisoned and slowed. The swarm then hangs over the spot for 3s, stinging anyone inside.

abilities.name: Spore Patch
abilities.text: On its own, when foes bunch up, Marchleaf puffs a 4s spore cloud on them: slowed and taking damage while inside.

abilities.name: Hive Crown
abilities.text: Marchleaf crowns you with its hive for 7s: 20% more damage, and every shot stings, poisons and slows.

d.lore: A leafcutter ant hauling a leaf ten times its size, with a column of tiny workers marching behind. It never stops working.
d.quirk: Trims the farm's leaves in neat half-moons; a ragged hedge means it is unhappy.

temper.name: Dutiful
temper.play: Gets in close and hits hard.

d.voice: busy foreman, counts things out loud

entries.entry: A leafcutter ant hauling a leaf ten times its size, with a column of tiny workers marching behind. It never stops working.
entries.habitat: Wild, on any island of the Skylands.
entries.lore: Marchleaf is an ant with a leaf for a body and fern curls for feelers, and a column of tiny workers marches behind it. It trims the farm's leaves in neat half-moons, so a ragged hedge means something has upset it.
entries.name: Marchleaf
entries.short: Marchleaf is an ant with a leaf for a body and fern curls for feelers, and a column of tiny workers marches behind it.

d.lore: Shinobant, art-lane design.

entries.entry: Shinobant, art-lane design.
entries.lore: Not every Marchleaf grows up to march. Shinobant is the quiet branch, a dark ant masked and scarfed in leaves that slips through a hedge without stirring a twig, where Scythant cuts its path in plain sight. The only sign it has passed is a single leaf, cut cleanly in half.
entries.name: Shinobant
entries.short: Not every Marchleaf grows up to march.

d.group: Small Boki: grown and final forms
d.lore: Soldier ant, leaf-blade mandibles.
d.quirk: Cuts a clean path through tall grass ahead of you on every walk.

entries.entry: Soldier ant, leaf-blade mandibles.
entries.lore: Its forelegs have grown into a pair of sickle blades. Where Shinobant hides, Scythant marches ahead on every walk and cuts a clean path through the tall grass, counting its strides out loud.
entries.name: Scythant
entries.short: Its forelegs have grown into a pair of sickle blades.

d.group: Small Boki: grown and final forms
d.lore: Winged drone-knight, twin scythe mandibles.
d.quirk: Stands guard at the mouth of its nest and lifts on its wings to meet anything that comes too close.
d.sexNote: Only male; every one is a winged drone-knight that guards the nest

entries.entry: Winged drone-knight, twin scythe mandibles.
entries.lore: Every Reapant is a male drone-knight, hooded in dark leaves and armed with twin scythe arms. It stands guard at the mouth of its nest and lifts on its wings to meet anything that comes too close, and no worker passes in or out without its nod.
entries.name: Reapant
entries.short: Every Reapant is a male drone-knight, hooded in dark leaves and armed with twin scythe arms.

entries.entry: Otter with oar-blade tail and oar spines.

entries.name: Oarter
entries.short: Oar spines line the body of this otter, and its tail has become a full oar blade.

entries.entry: War-galley otter: oar spines down its sides, ram brow.
entries.lore: Built like a war galley, Galleotter has oars fanned along its back and a chest plated like a hull. It rams anything floating in the pond and stacks the wreckage neatly on the bank.
entries.name: Galleotter
entries.short: Built like a war galley, Galleotter has oars fanned along its back and a chest plated like a hull.

entries.entry: Tiny serpent with paper-kite fins.
entries.lore: Kitlet is a cream dragonet with a little red paper kite on its back and bows tied down its tail. It catches updrafts off the roof and hovers there for hours, coming down only when someone calls its name. The kite grows as Kitlet does.
entries.name: Kitlet
entries.short: Kitlet is a cream dragonet with a little red paper kite on its back and bows tied down its tail.

d.lore: Long kite-tail dragon, ribbon streamers.

entries.entry: Long kite-tail dragon, ribbon streamers.
entries.lore: Ribbonwyrm is a long cream serpent with diamond kite fins down its body and a tail of ribbon bows. The bows always point into the wind, and sky fishers watch which way they fly before casting their lines.
entries.name: Ribbonwyrm
entries.short: Ribbonwyrm is a long cream serpent with diamond kite fins down its body and a tail of ribbon bows.

d.lore: Majestic sky dragon, kite-frame wings, crossbar spine.
d.quirk: Only flies when the wind is up; on still days it lies on the warm roof.

entries.entry: Majestic sky dragon, kite-frame wings, crossbar spine.
entries.lore: Kitedrake is a great cream dragon with two huge kite wings and a tail strung like a chain of little kites. It only flies when the wind is up; on still days it lies on a warm roof and waits.
entries.name: Kitedrake
entries.short: Kitedrake is a great cream dragon with two huge kite wings and a tail strung like a chain of little kites.

d.lore: Hermit crab living in a glass jar.
d.quirk: Swaps jars when it finds a prettier one and leaves the old one at your door.

entries.entry: Hermit crab living in a glass jar.
entries.lore: Instead of a shell, Jarmit lives in a glass jar. Whenever it finds a prettier one, it moves in at once and leaves the old jar on your doorstep, as if returning something it borrowed.
entries.name: Jarmit
entries.short: Instead of a shell, Jarmit lives in a glass jar.

d.lore: Moves into an oil lantern.
d.quirk: Glows as dusk falls and dims when strangers come near.

entries.entry: Moves into an oil lantern.
entries.lore: This Jarmit has moved into an old oil lantern and taken on its glow. Lanternmit brightens as dusk falls and dims to almost nothing when strangers come near.
entries.name: Lanternmit
entries.short: This Jarmit has moved into an old oil lantern and taken on its glow.

d.lore: Moves into a coil-wrapped storm bottle.
d.quirk: Its bottle crackles louder before a storm; keep it off the wooden shelf.

entries.entry: Moves into a coil-wrapped storm bottle.
entries.lore: Stormit lives under a glass dome with a storm cloud trapped inside, and tiny lightning bolts flicker in the glass. Before a storm the dome crackles louder, so keepers move it off any wooden shelf.
entries.name: Stormit
entries.short: Stormit lives under a glass dome with a storm cloud trapped inside, and tiny lightning bolts flicker in the glass.

d.lore: Moves into a mossy terrarium.
d.quirk: The moss in its shell grows a single flower when it is content.

entries.entry: Moves into a mossy terrarium.
entries.lore: Some Jarmit settle into a cracked garden pot full of moss and never leave. The little tree growing from Terrarimit's pot opens a single flower when it is content, and the flower wilts within the hour if it is upset.
entries.name: Terrarimit
entries.short: Some Jarmit settle into a cracked garden pot full of moss and never leave.

d.lore: A nautilus that is a tiny bathysphere.

entries.entry: A nautilus that is a tiny bathysphere.
entries.lore: Bathilus sinks to the bottom of deep ponds to look around through its single round porthole eye. The tiny bathysphere rises again later with bubbles streaming from its rivets.
entries.name: Bathilus
entries.short: Bathilus sinks to the bottom of deep ponds to look around through its single round porthole eye.

entries.category: Orthocone (extinct straight-shelled nautiloid) + torpedo (the eye is the nose, the arms are the fins)

d.lore: A living torpedo whose seeker nose is Bathilus's porthole eye and whose arms have fused into its tail fins.

entries.entry: A living torpedo whose seeker nose is Bathilus's porthole eye and whose arms have fused into its tail fins.
entries.lore: Torpecone is a living torpedo. The porthole eye it had as Bathilus is now its seeker nose, and its arms have fused into tail fins. Once it locks onto something, it does not turn aside.
entries.name: Torpecone
entries.short: Torpecone is a living torpedo.

d.lore: A giant ammonite that is a battleship.

entries.entry: A giant ammonite that is a battleship.
entries.lore: A giant ammonite that is a whole battleship, its coiled shell bristling with armour plate. When Dreadmonite surfaces, every smaller Boki in the water gets out of its way, and so do the boats.
entries.name: Dreadmonite
entries.short: A giant ammonite that is a whole battleship, its coiled shell bristling with armour plate.

d.lore: A platypus whose bill is a folded pocket knife.

entries.entry: A platypus whose bill is a folded pocket knife.
entries.lore: Pocketpus sleeps folded up tight like a closed pocket knife, bill tucked to tail. The little platypus snaps open when startled, and the spurs on its heels already glow with venom. It grows into Bladypus once it learns what else it can unfold.
entries.name: Pocketpus
entries.short: Pocketpus sleeps folded up tight like a closed pocket knife, bill tucked to tail.

d.lore: A platypus that is an open multi-tool.

entries.entry: A platypus that is an open multi-tool.
entries.lore: Bladypus is a platypus that opens out like a multi-tool, with a little blade, file or hook for every job. The spurs on its hind legs carry venom, so it is best handed back the way it was passed to you.
entries.name: Bladypus
entries.short: Bladypus is a platypus that opens out like a multi-tool, with a little blade, file or hook for every job.

d.lore: A heavy platypus whose whole body has opened into a butcher's multi-tool.

entries.entry: A heavy platypus whose whole body has opened into a butcher's multi-tool.
entries.lore: Cleavypus has unfolded every blade it owns and never folds shut again. It lurks in river shallows with its saw and hook raised like reeds, and one slap of its cleaver tail splits a drifting log.
entries.name: Cleavypus
entries.short: Cleavypus has unfolded every blade it owns and never folds shut again.

d.lore: A pufferfish that is a cartoon bomb.

entries.entry: A pufferfish that is a cartoon bomb.
entries.lore: When Puffuse gets nervous it puffs up and the fuse on its head starts to fizz. The pufferfish is shaped exactly like a round cartoon bomb, so the kindest thing is to calm it down quickly.
entries.name: Puffuse
entries.short: When Puffuse gets nervous it puffs up and the fuse on its head starts to fizz.

d.lore: A spiny puffer that has hardened into a grenade.

entries.entry: A spiny puffer that has hardened into a grenade.
entries.lore: Its spines have grown into a burst of long golden spikes, like a firework caught mid-bang. Blastopuff stays perfectly calm almost all the time, which is just as well, because the one time it loses its temper is usually remembered.
entries.name: Blastopuff
entries.short: Its spines have grown into a burst of long golden spikes, like a firework caught mid-bang.

d.lore: A single living drop of glossy black ink.

entries.entry: A single living drop of glossy black ink.
entries.lore: Shy enough to hide in an inkwell, Blotlet is a single living drop of glossy black ink. It leaves a tiny dot wherever it rests, and a page covered in dots means it slept on your desk.
entries.name: Blotlet
entries.short: Shy enough to hide in an inkwell, Blotlet is a single living drop of glossy black ink.

d.lore: A spreading pool of living ink that creeps along the ground.

entries.entry: A spreading pool of living ink that creeps along the ground.
entries.lore: Slog is a spreading pool of living ink that creeps along the ground, a grinning shadow just beneath the surface. Lamps flicker when it passes under a door, and it seems to enjoy that very much.
entries.name: Slog
entries.short: Slog is a spreading pool of living ink that creeps along the ground, a grinning shadow just beneath the surface.

entries.category: Ink tidal wave + looming shadow beast

d.lore: The ink pool risen into a towering wave of shadow.

entries.entry: The ink pool risen into a towering wave of shadow.
entries.lore: The ink pool has risen into a towering wave of shadow with something looming inside it. Sloggoth moves without a sound, and where it rolls back, the ground is left stained black for a season.
entries.name: Sloggoth
entries.short: The ink pool has risen into a towering wave of shadow with something looming inside it.

d.lore: A tadpole with a dart-flight tail.

entries.entry: A tadpole with a dart-flight tail.
entries.lore: Bullpole is a red tadpole with a tail feathered like the flight of a dart. It lines itself up on a lily pad, wriggles, and launches, missing more often than not. It sulks under a leaf after every miss, which is how Bullsfrog learned to stop missing.
entries.name: Bullpole
entries.short: Bullpole is a red tadpole with a tail feathered like the flight of a dart.

d.lore: A poison dart frog that is the whole game of darts.

entries.entry: A poison dart frog that is the whole game of darts.
entries.lore: Bullsfrog never misses the centre ring, and it sulks when anyone else does. The poison dart frog carries a dartboard on its back and darts for fingers.
entries.name: Bullsfrog
entries.short: Bullsfrog never misses the centre ring, and it sulks when anyone else does.

d.lore: A baby centipede of stacked steel bottle caps, their crimped edges its many little legs.

entries.entry: A baby centipede of stacked steel bottle caps, their crimped edges its many little legs.
entries.lore: Clinkpede clinks softly as it walks on the crimped edges of the steel bottle caps it is made of. The baby centipede hunts scrapyards for new caps to add to its length.
entries.name: Clinkpede
entries.short: Clinkpede clinks softly as it walks on the crimped edges of the steel bottle caps it is made of.

d.lore: A centipede that is a living chainsaw chain.

entries.entry: A centipede that is a living chainsaw chain.
entries.lore: Clinkpede's bottle caps have hardened into the links of a saw chain, every leg a hooked tooth. When Chainipede runs, the whole length of it whirs, and it leaves a neat groove in whatever it crosses. The green on its teeth is venom, so woodcutters let it keep the log.
entries.name: Chainipede
entries.short: Clinkpede's bottle caps have hardened into the links of a saw chain, every leg a hooked tooth.

d.lore: A wombat joey that is a fuzzy die.

entries.entry: A wombat joey that is a fuzzy die.
entries.lore: When Cubwom tumbles over, islanders call out the number of pips that lands on top. The wombat joey is a fuzzy die, and some villages play whole games of chance around it.
entries.name: Cubwom
entries.short: When Cubwom tumbles over, islanders call out the number of pips that lands on top.

d.lore: A wombat whose rump is a six-pip shield die.

entries.entry: A wombat whose rump is a six-pip shield die.
entries.lore: Pipwom's rump has squared off into a hard die showing six pips, and it backs into its burrow to block the door with it. Islanders say meeting one rump-first is good luck. It grew from Cubwom and still tumbles over when it is excited.
entries.name: Pipwom
entries.short: Pipwom's rump has squared off into a hard die showing six pips, and it backs into its burrow to block the door with it.

d.lore: A glyptodont-sized wombat whose shell is a twenty-sided die.

entries.entry: A glyptodont-sized wombat whose shell is a twenty-sided die.
entries.lore: Critwom is a wombat the size of a boulder, armoured in a shell cut like a many-sided die and swinging a spiked ball of a tail. Villages hold their breath to see which face is up when it settles for the night. Whatever it shows, nobody argues with it.
entries.name: Critwom
entries.short: Critwom is a wombat the size of a boulder, armoured in a shell cut like a many-sided die and swinging a spiked ball of a tail.

entries.category: Hellgrammite larva + crossed swords (the mandibles are the blades)

d.lore: A curled river larva carrying its two blade jaws crossed in an X, like crossed swords.

entries.entry: A curled river larva carrying its two blade jaws crossed in an X, like crossed swords.
entries.lore: A curled river larva carrying its two blade jaws crossed in an X, like a pair of swords. Grammite hides under stones in fast streams and raises its blades at anything that lifts the stone.
entries.name: Grammite
entries.short: A curled river larva carrying its two blade jaws crossed in an X, like a pair of swords.

d.lore: A dobsonfly whose jaws are crossed cavalry sabres.

entries.entry: A dobsonfly whose jaws are crossed cavalry sabres.
entries.lore: When Grammite leaves the river, its jaws become a pair of crossed cavalry sabres. Dobsabre flies at dusk with them held high and salutes before every duel.
entries.name: Dobsabre
entries.short: When Grammite leaves the river, its jaws become a pair of crossed cavalry sabres.

d.lore: A baby chameleon curled up like a rolled star chart, peering through one brass lens eye.

entries.entry: A baby chameleon curled up like a rolled star chart, peering through one brass lens eye.
entries.lore: Curled up like a rolled star chart, Lensling peers out through one brass lens eye. The baby chameleon spends whole nights staring at a single star and sulks if clouds cover it.
entries.name: Lensling
entries.short: Curled up like a rolled star chart, Lensling peers out through one brass lens eye.

d.lore: A chameleon whose swivelling eyes are two brass spyglasses.

entries.entry: A chameleon whose swivelling eyes are two brass spyglasses.
entries.lore: Scopeleon's swivelling eyes are two brass spyglasses that extend to look at anything far away. It can watch a hawk on one island and a skiff on the next at the same time.
entries.name: Scopeleon
entries.short: Scopeleon's swivelling eyes are two brass spyglasses that extend to look at anything far away.

d.lore: A giant chameleon that is a living observatory, its crest a great telescope.

entries.entry: A giant chameleon that is a living observatory, its crest a great telescope.
entries.lore: This giant chameleon is a living observatory, its crest a great brass telescope. Star charts made by people who stayed up beside Domeleon are said to show stars no one else has seen.
entries.name: Domeleon
entries.short: This giant chameleon is a living observatory, its crest a great brass telescope.

entries.category: Fawn + broad dappled mushroom caps (grown as its ears)

d.lore: A resting fawn whose two big floppy ears are dappled mushroom caps.

entries.entry: A resting fawn whose two big floppy ears are dappled mushroom caps.
entries.lore: Fawnshroom lies so still in the leaf litter that foragers have tried to pick its ears, which are big, floppy, dappled mushroom caps. The fawn has never quite forgiven them.
entries.name: Fawnshroom
entries.short: Fawnshroom lies so still in the leaf litter that foragers have tried to pick its ears, which are big, floppy, dappled mushroom caps.

d.lore: An Irish elk whose antlers are a hat stand hung with mushroom caps.

entries.entry: An Irish elk whose antlers are a hat stand hung with mushroom caps.
entries.lore: Hatstag is a towering elk whose antlers are a hat stand, hung with mushroom caps of every size. Travellers hang their own hats there too, and it seems proud to carry them.
entries.name: Hatstag
entries.short: Hatstag is a towering elk whose antlers are a hat stand, hung with mushroom caps of every size.

d.lore: A bat pup folded up like a closed fan.

entries.entry: A bat pup folded up like a closed fan.
entries.lore: Foldbat rests folded up like a closed fan. When the bat pup flicks itself open, it gives off a sharp crack of sound that scatters anything nearby, and then it folds shut again, embarrassed.
entries.name: Foldbat
entries.short: Foldbat rests folded up like a closed fan.

d.lore: A flying fox whose wings are iron war fans.

entries.entry: A flying fox whose wings are iron war fans.
entries.lore: Fanpire's wings are iron war fans painted with swirling clouds, and it snaps them open with a crack that carries across the valley. The grown Foldbat hangs shut and silent all day, then fans itself awake at dusk. One gust from its wings can put out every lantern on a street.
entries.name: Fanpire
entries.short: Fanpire's wings are iron war fans painted with swirling clouds, and it snaps them open with a crack that carries across the valley.

d.lore: A Gila monster whose beaded hide is an abacus.

entries.entry: A Gila monster whose beaded hide is an abacus.
entries.lore: The beaded hide of this Gila monster is an abacus, with rows of beads that slide as it breathes. Gilabacus keeps count of everything, and market traders swear it knows when it has been shortchanged.
entries.name: Gilabacus
entries.short: The beaded hide of this Gila monster is an abacus, with rows of beads that slide as it breathes.

d.lore: The cave folklore 'baby dragon', made of mended porcelain.

entries.entry: The cave folklore 'baby dragon', made of mended porcelain.
entries.lore: Cave folk once told stories of baby dragons, and Olmlet is where those stories came from. It is pale, blue-painted and made of porcelain mended many times over, and it cheeps when it hears footsteps.
entries.name: Olmlet
entries.short: Cave folk once told stories of baby dragons, and Olmlet is where those stories came from.

d.lore: A salamander of crackle-glaze pottery mended with gold.

entries.entry: A salamander of crackle-glaze pottery mended with gold.
entries.lore: Glazolm is a salamander of crackle-glaze pottery, every crack filled with gold. It keeps its old breaks proudly on show and gets a little brighter each time it is mended.
entries.name: Glazolm
entries.short: Glazolm is a salamander of crackle-glaze pottery, every crack filled with gold.

d.lore: A dragon that was shattered and glued back together with gold.

entries.entry: A dragon that was shattered and glued back together with gold.
entries.lore: A dragon that was shattered and glued back together with gold, more seams than porcelain by now. Gildwyrm is said to be stronger at every mended place, and it shows them off when it uncoils.
entries.name: Gildwyrm
entries.short: A dragon that was shattered and glued back together with gold, more seams than porcelain by now.

d.lore: A spiderling with a sand-timer belly.

entries.entry: A spiderling with a sand-timer belly.
entries.lore: Grainspin carries a round glass of sand on its back. The sand runs from top to bottom over exactly one hour, and when the last grain falls, the spiderling flips over and starts the next. Males are tan with golden sand; females are plum with lilac sand.
entries.name: Grainspin
entries.short: Grainspin carries a round glass of sand on its back.

d.lore: A black widow whose red hourglass mark is a real glass hourglass.

entries.entry: A black widow whose red hourglass mark is a real glass hourglass.
entries.lore: The hourglass on this widow spider's back is a real glass hourglass. Sandwidow waits on its web until the sand runs out, and whatever is caught by then is dinner. Males are black with red sand; females are plum with lilac sand.
entries.name: Sandwidow
entries.short: The hourglass on this widow spider's back is a real glass hourglass.

d.lore: A giant spider that is a toppled hourglass half buried in a desert.

entries.entry: A giant spider that is a toppled hourglass half buried in a desert.
entries.lore: Hourachnid is a giant spider with a tilted hourglass on its back and a crescent moon caught in the glass. Desert travellers find one half buried in a dune and take it for a ruin until it stands up. Males are sand-coloured with golden sand; females are dark with white bands and carry red sand.
entries.name: Hourachnid
entries.short: Hourachnid is a giant spider with a tilted hourglass on its back and a crescent moon caught in the glass.

entries.category: Baby frilled lizard + vinyl record (the open frill disc)

d.lore: A baby frilled lizard whose round open frill is a black vinyl record, its face the label.

entries.entry: A baby frilled lizard whose round open frill is a black vinyl record, its face the label.
entries.lore: Spin a Tootle and its frill plays a scratchy little tune. The baby frilled lizard's round open frill is a black vinyl record, with its own face as the label.
entries.name: Tootle
entries.short: Spin a Tootle and its frill plays a scratchy little tune.

d.lore: A frilled lizard whose frill is a gramophone horn.

entries.entry: A frilled lizard whose frill is a gramophone horn.
entries.lore: Gramofrill's frill has opened out into a gramophone horn. It plays back songs it heard years ago, crackle and all, and it hates being interrupted halfway through a track.
entries.name: Gramofrill
entries.short: Gramofrill's frill has opened out into a gramophone horn.

d.lore: A dragon whose crown is four gramophone horns.

entries.entry: A dragon whose crown is four gramophone horns.
entries.lore: A dragon crowned with four gramophone horns, each pointing in a different direction. Phonodrake can play four songs at once, and when it roars, all four join in.
entries.name: Phonodrake
entries.short: A dragon crowned with four gramophone horns, each pointing in a different direction.

d.lore: A grub that has curled itself into a crescent moon. (Redesigned 11-09: four rounds kept drawing a grub hugging a separate moon ball, which reads as a held object.).

entries.entry: A grub that has curled itself into a crescent moon. (Redesigned 11-09: four rounds kept drawing a grub hugging a separate moon ball, which reads as a held object.).
entries.lore: Gravigrub curls itself into a crescent moon and sleeps all day. At night it rolls out, and small loose things nearby slowly start to circle it.
entries.name: Gravigrub
entries.short: Gravigrub curls itself into a crescent moon and sleeps all day.

d.lore: A dung beetle whose rear end is a ringed planet.

entries.entry: A dung beetle whose rear end is a ringed planet.
entries.lore: Orbitle is a dung beetle whose rear end is a ringed planet. Small pebbles drift along its rings, and anything it rolls along the ground tends to follow it home.
entries.name: Orbitle
entries.short: Orbitle is a dung beetle whose rear end is a ringed planet.

d.lore: A scarab that has opened into a living orrery.

entries.entry: A scarab that has opened into a living orrery.
entries.lore: Some Orbitle open their shells and never close them again. Scarabit is a dark scarab circled by slow rings and drifting little moons, where its sibling Meteorab falls like a stone. Stargazers follow one for nights to learn which way the heavens turn.
entries.name: Scarabit
entries.short: Some Orbitle open their shells and never close them again.

d.lore: A beetle that is a falling meteorite with a horn.

entries.entry: A beetle that is a falling meteorite with a horn.
entries.lore: Other Orbitle grow heavy instead and become Meteorab, a horned beetle of scorched rock with fire glowing in its cracks. It climbs to the highest ledge it can find and drops. The dents it leaves in a field stay warm until morning.
entries.name: Meteorab
entries.short: Other Orbitle grow heavy instead and become Meteorab, a horned beetle of scorched rock with fire glowing in its cracks.

entries.category: Katydid nymph + ball of rising dough

d.lore: A katydid nymph that is a ball of rising dough.

entries.entry: A katydid nymph that is a ball of rising dough.
entries.lore: Proofhop swells a little bigger every warm afternoon, a katydid nymph made of rising dough. It sinks back down sulking if anyone pokes it before it is ready.
entries.name: Proofhop
entries.short: Proofhop swells a little bigger every warm afternoon, a katydid nymph made of rising dough.

d.lore: A katydid that is a scored sourdough loaf, crust spikes and all.

entries.entry: A katydid that is a scored sourdough loaf, crust spikes and all.
entries.lore: Loafhopper is a katydid baked into a scored sourdough loaf, crust spikes and all. Its crust crackles when it jumps, and the farm smells of fresh bread for an hour wherever it lands.
entries.name: Loafhopper
entries.short: Loafhopper is a katydid baked into a scored sourdough loaf, crust spikes and all.

d.lore: An anglerfish fry whose mouth is a tiny sprung trap.

entries.entry: An anglerfish fry whose mouth is a tiny sprung trap.
entries.lore: An anglerfish fry whose mouth is a tiny sprung trap. Lurklet dangles a little lure from its head and snaps shut on anything curious enough to come close, including fingers.
entries.name: Lurklet
entries.short: An anglerfish fry whose mouth is a tiny sprung trap.

d.lore: A flat anglerfish that is a living bear trap.

entries.entry: A flat anglerfish that is a living bear trap.
entries.lore: Snapler lies hidden in the mud with its jaws wide open, a flat anglerfish that is a living bear trap. The only warning is the faint glint of its lure.
entries.name: Snapler
entries.short: Snapler lies hidden in the mud with its jaws wide open, a flat anglerfish that is a living bear trap.

d.lore: A walking frogfish whose whole body snaps shut like a giant trap.

entries.entry: A walking frogfish whose whole body snaps shut like a giant trap.
entries.lore: Maulangler walks along the seabed on stubby fins, and its whole body snaps shut like a giant trap. It is slow, patient and very hard to get out of once it has closed.
entries.name: Maulangler
entries.short: Maulangler walks along the seabed on stubby fins, and its whole body snaps shut like a giant trap.

entries.category: Secretary bird + cast iron (its dark leg feathering grown into heavy riveted iron)

d.lore: A secretary bird whose black "trousers" have turned to cast iron: two short, heavy iron stomper legs.

entries.entry: A secretary bird whose black "trousers" have turned to cast iron: two short, heavy iron stomper legs.
entries.lore: A secretary bird whose black leg feathers have turned to cast iron, leaving it with two short, heavy stomping legs. Malletary hunts by stamping, and the ground shakes every time it finds something.
entries.name: Malletary
entries.short: A secretary bird whose black leg feathers have turned to cast iron, leaving it with two short, heavy stomping legs.

d.lore: A baby rattlesnake with a maraca tail.

entries.entry: A baby rattlesnake with a maraca tail.
entries.lore: Rattlebub shakes its maraca tail constantly, mostly to hear itself. The baby rattlesnake keeps it going all through supper and falls asleep only when the rattle finally runs out of rhythm.
entries.name: Rattlebub
entries.short: Rattlebub shakes its maraca tail constantly, mostly to hear itself.

d.lore: A rattlesnake that is a pair of maracas.

entries.entry: A rattlesnake that is a pair of maracas.
entries.lore: Maracoil is a rattlesnake that is a pair of maracas, one at each end. It shakes a steady beat before it strikes, and some islanders dance to the rhythm without realising it is a warning.
entries.name: Maracoil
entries.short: Maracoil is a rattlesnake that is a pair of maracas, one at each end.

d.lore: A jellyfish polyp that is a walking button mushroom.

entries.entry: A jellyfish polyp that is a walking button mushroom.
entries.lore: At night Polyshroom walks out of the water and plants itself in damp soil. The jellyfish polyp is a little button mushroom on a stalk, and it is easy to mistake for an ordinary one.
entries.name: Polyshroom
entries.short: At night Polyshroom walks out of the water and plants itself in damp soil.

d.lore: A baby jellyfish that is a spinning mushroom throwing star.

entries.entry: A baby jellyfish that is a spinning mushroom throwing star.
entries.lore: Starcap is a young jellyfish that floats through the air under a soft mushroom cap lobed like a star. It drops a fine dust of spores wherever it drifts.
entries.name: Starcap
entries.short: Starcap is a young jellyfish that floats through the air under a soft mushroom cap lobed like a star.

d.lore: A jellyfish whose bell is a toadstool cap.

entries.entry: A jellyfish whose bell is a toadstool cap.
entries.lore: Medushroom drifts slowly over damp forests, its bell a broad toadstool cap trailing long stinging threads. Wherever its shadow passes in the night, the ground below has sprouted a fresh ring of mushrooms by morning.
entries.name: Medushroom
entries.short: Medushroom drifts slowly over damp forests, its bell a broad toadstool cap trailing long stinging threads.

entries.category: Tapir calf + morel mushroom (its whole body is the cap)

d.lore: A tapir calf sitting on its haunches, shaped and pitted exactly like a plump morel.

entries.entry: A tapir calf sitting on its haunches, shaped and pitted exactly like a plump morel.
entries.lore: Foragers who come home with a Morelkin in the basket usually find it followed them out of the woods on purpose. The tapir calf sits on its haunches, pitted exactly like a plump morel.
entries.name: Morelkin
entries.short: Foragers who come home with a Morelkin in the basket usually find it followed them out of the woods on purpose.

d.lore: A tapir that has become the truffle it was hunting.

entries.entry: A tapir that has become the truffle it was hunting.
entries.lore: Truffapir is a tapir that hunted truffles so long it became one. Its snout can find a buried truffle under a whole field, but it refuses to share where it found any.
entries.name: Truffapir
entries.short: Truffapir is a tapir that hunted truffles so long it became one.

d.lore: A prehistoric giant tapir whose spine has grown into a ridge of morel towers.

entries.entry: A prehistoric giant tapir whose spine has grown into a ridge of morel towers.
entries.lore: The spine of this giant, tusked tapir has grown into a ridge of morel towers, tall enough to be seen over the treetops. Morelossus moves slowly, and the forest behind it sprouts mushrooms for weeks.
entries.name: Morelossus
entries.short: The spine of this giant, tusked tapir has grown into a ridge of morel towers, tall enough to be seen over the treetops.

d.lore: A dragonfly nymph that is a rosebud of leaded glass, its wing pads curled shut like petals.

entries.entry: A dragonfly nymph that is a rosebud of leaded glass, its wing pads curled shut like petals.
entries.lore: A dragonfly nymph that is a rosebud of leaded stained glass, its wing pads curled shut like petals. When morning light shines through Nymphane, it throws coloured patches across the pond.
entries.name: Nymphane
entries.short: A dragonfly nymph that is a rosebud of leaded stained glass, its wing pads curled shut like petals.

d.lore: A dragonfly whose wings are a cathedral rose window.

entries.entry: A dragonfly whose wings are a cathedral rose window.
entries.lore: When Nymphane's glass bud opens, its wings unfold into a cathedral rose window. Rosedart hovers where the sun can shine through them, and the pond below turns every colour at once. Its tail ends in a point as sharp as a spear, which it keeps politely out of the way.
entries.name: Rosedart
entries.short: When Nymphane's glass bud opens, its wings unfold into a cathedral rose window.

d.lore: A seahorse fry that is a chess pawn.

entries.entry: A seahorse fry that is a chess pawn.
entries.lore: Pawnfry only ever moves forward, one hop at a time. The seahorse fry is shaped exactly like a chess pawn, and it dreams of reaching the far side of the pond.
entries.name: Pawnfry
entries.short: Pawnfry only ever moves forward, one hop at a time.

d.lore: A seahorse that is a carved chess knight.

entries.entry: A seahorse that is a carved chess knight.
entries.lore: Pawnfry that reach the far side of the pond come back as Gambitfin, a seahorse carved like a chess knight. It never swims in a straight line, always a little forward and then off to one side. Nobody has yet guessed where one will turn up next.
entries.name: Gambitfin
entries.short: Pawnfry that reach the far side of the pond come back as Gambitfin, a seahorse carved like a chess knight.

d.lore: A leafy sea dragon that has been promoted to chess queen.

entries.entry: A leafy sea dragon that has been promoted to chess queen.
entries.lore: Checkmare is a crowned sea dragon striped like a chessboard, with a row of little chess pieces standing along its back. It moves any way it pleases, and everything in the water makes room. Islanders bow to it, mostly as a joke, and it nods back as if it were not one.
entries.name: Checkmare
entries.short: Checkmare is a crowned sea dragon striped like a chessboard, with a row of little chess pieces standing along its back.

d.lore: A lamb whose curly fleece is tide-worn sea-glass pebbles.

entries.entry: A lamb whose curly fleece is tide-worn sea-glass pebbles.
entries.lore: This lamb's curly fleece is made of tide-worn pebbles of frosted sea glass. Pebblamb clinks softly when it runs, and shepherds find stray bits of sea glass wherever it has rolled in the grass.
entries.name: Pebblamb
entries.short: This lamb's curly fleece is made of tide-worn pebbles of frosted sea glass.

entries.entry: Evolution of Pebblamb.

entries.category: Thylacine (extinct) + film clapperboard; the last thylacine was filmed in black and white, yawning its huge gape

d.lore: The last thylacine as an old film's clapperboard: its famous wide gape is the striped clapper.

entries.entry: The last thylacine as an old film's clapperboard: its famous wide gape is the striped clapper.
entries.lore: Reelacine is a thylacine that is an old film clapperboard, its famous wide gape the striped clapper. Every time it yawns, the jaws snap shut with a loud clack, as if starting a new scene.
entries.name: Reelacine
entries.short: Reelacine is a thylacine that is an old film clapperboard, its famous wide gape the striped clapper.

d.lore: A dormouse curled up as a scoop of ice cream.

entries.entry: A dormouse curled up as a scoop of ice cream.
entries.lore: Scoopsy sleeps curled up in a waffle cone, a dormouse swirled in pink, blue and cream. It melts a little in the midday sun and has to be carried into the shade, still asleep. It has never once woken up for this.
entries.name: Scoopsy
entries.short: Scoopsy sleeps curled up in a waffle cone, a dormouse swirled in pink, blue and cream.

d.lore: A dormouse that is a soft-serve with a waffle-cone spike tail.

entries.entry: A dormouse that is a soft-serve with a waffle-cone spike tail.
entries.lore: Sundormouse sleeps through every warm afternoon, because the heat makes it droop. The dormouse is a swirl of soft-serve with a waffle-cone spike for a tail, and it wakes fresh as the evening cools.
entries.name: Sundormouse
entries.short: Sundormouse sleeps through every warm afternoon, because the heat makes it droop.

d.lore: A full-grown soft-serve dormouse with ice fangs and a spiked cone-club tail.

entries.entry: A full-grown soft-serve dormouse with ice fangs and a spiked cone-club tail.
entries.lore: Sorbeast is what a Sundormouse becomes once it stops sleeping through the cold. It prowls glacier edges at dusk, and its two ice fangs freeze whatever they bite; one swing of its spiked cone tail shatters a frozen pond.
entries.name: Sorbeast
entries.short: Sorbeast is what a Sundormouse becomes once it stops sleeping through the cold.

d.lore: Bonsolith, art-lane design.

entries.entry: Bonsolith, art-lane design.
entries.lore: A blossoming tree grows from the back of this old stone-scaled dragon, and petals lie caught between its scales. Bonsolith moves so slowly that the tree never drops a flower out of season. Gardeners come a long way to sit beside it and prune nothing.
entries.name: Bonsolith
entries.short: A blossoming tree grows from the back of this old stone-scaled dragon, and petals lie caught between its scales.

d.lore: A pterosaur hatchling knapped out of flint.

entries.entry: A pterosaur hatchling knapped out of flint.
entries.lore: Chiptero is a pterosaur hatchling chipped out of flint, all sharp flakes and big eyes. It sheds a few chips whenever it lands badly, which is most landings. Strike two of them together and they spark, so campers follow it about.
entries.name: Chiptero
entries.short: Chiptero is a pterosaur hatchling chipped out of flint, all sharp flakes and big eyes.

d.lore: A pterosaur whose head is a double pickaxe.

entries.entry: A pterosaur whose head is a double pickaxe.
entries.lore: Its head has grown into a double pickaxe, and Pickadactyl swings it into cliff faces to dig out a roost. The flint shards it knocks loose rain down for an hour afterwards. Miners follow the sound, because it only digs where the rock is good.
entries.name: Pickadactyl
entries.short: Its head has grown into a double pickaxe, and Pickadactyl swings it into cliff faces to dig out a roost.

d.lore: A cicada nymph with a speaker-grille back that has not made a sound yet.

entries.entry: A cicada nymph with a speaker-grille back that has not made a sound yet.
entries.lore: Mumblet's back is a round speaker grille that has not made a sound yet. The cicada nymph sits underground for years, listening and practising in its head. Put an ear to the soil above one and you may hear it thinking very loudly.
entries.name: Mumblet
entries.short: Mumblet's back is a round speaker grille that has not made a sound yet.

d.lore: A cicada whose abdomen is a klaxon horn.

entries.entry: A cicada whose abdomen is a klaxon horn.
entries.lore: The day Mumblet finds its voice, its tail swells into a brass klaxon horn. Klaxada honks at sunrise, at visitors, and at nothing at all, delighted every time. Farms that keep one give up on roosters.
entries.name: Klaxada
entries.short: The day Mumblet finds its voice, its tail swells into a brass klaxon horn.

d.lore: A giant cicada that is a living air-raid siren.

entries.entry: A giant cicada that is a living air-raid siren.
entries.lore: Sirencada is a giant cicada with a pair of brass horns and a spinning siren on its back. Its wail rises slowly and carries from one island to the next. It only sounds when real danger is coming, so everyone who hears it runs first and asks later.
entries.name: Sirencada
entries.short: Sirencada is a giant cicada with a pair of brass horns and a spinning siren on its back.

d.lore: A narwhal calf whose tusk is a fencing foil.

entries.entry: A narwhal calf whose tusk is a fencing foil.
entries.lore: Narfoil's little tusk is a fencing foil, guard and all, and it pokes at everything it meets to see what happens. The narwhal calf sticks its tongue out after every hit. It bows before it starts, most of the time.
entries.name: Narfoil
entries.short: Narfoil's little tusk is a fencing foil, guard and all, and it pokes at everything it meets to see what happens.

d.lore: A narwhal that is a fencing champion: epee tusk, bell-guard brow, parry fins.

entries.entry: A narwhal that is a fencing champion: epee tusk, bell-guard brow, parry fins.
entries.lore: Parrywhal carries a long duelling blade for a tusk, with a guard across its brow and fins edged like swords. It salutes before a bout and has never struck an opponent who was not ready. Young Narfoil trail after it, copying every turn.
entries.name: Parrywhal
entries.short: Parrywhal carries a long duelling blade for a tusk, with a guard across its brow and fins edged like swords.

d.lore: A baby iguana with one temple-roof eave for a crest.

entries.entry: A baby iguana with one temple-roof eave for a crest.
entries.lore: A single curled roof eave of red tile sits on Pagodito's head, and it is very proud of it. The baby iguana basks on warm temple steps and will not come down while the sun is out. Rain runs neatly off the eave and onto whoever is standing next to it.
entries.name: Pagodito
entries.short: A single curled roof eave of red tile sits on Pagodito's head, and it is very proud of it.

d.lore: A young anole whose crest has grown into a two-tier temple roof.

entries.entry: A young anole whose crest has grown into a two-tier temple roof.
entries.lore: Pagonole's single eave has grown a second tier, and the red tiles now run from its head down onto its shoulders. It climbs temple walls looking for the warmest roof and sits there all afternoon, comparing its own tiles to the ones under its feet. The first green scales along its spine show the colour it will wear when it is grown.
entries.name: Pagonole
entries.short: Pagonole's single eave has grown a second tier, and the red tiles now run from its head down onto its shoulders.

d.lore: A marine iguana whose crest is a five-tier pagoda.

entries.entry: A marine iguana whose crest is a five-tier pagoda.
entries.lore: The single eave has grown into a whole pagoda of tiled roofs climbing down its back. Pagoguana rears up on its hind legs to sun every tier at once. Small birds nest under the eaves, and it holds still through the whole nesting season.
entries.name: Pagoguana
entries.short: The single eave has grown into a whole pagoda of tiled roofs climbing down its back.

d.lore: A hamster whose stuffed cheeks are pinball bumpers.

entries.entry: A hamster whose stuffed cheeks are pinball bumpers.
entries.lore: Pinster is a pill bug of polished chrome that curls into a perfect silver ball. It rolls downhill for fun and rings like a bell off every stone it hits. It keeps score, though nobody knows of what.
entries.name: Pinster
entries.short: Pinster is a pill bug of polished chrome that curls into a perfect silver ball.

d.lore: A hamster that is a whole pinball machine.

entries.entry: A hamster that is a whole pinball machine.
entries.lore: Tiltster's back has opened into a whole pinball table under glass, with lights, bumpers and a pair of flipper claws. A Pinster or two can usually be found rolling about inside. Tip it even slightly and every light goes dark, and it sulks until someone says sorry.
entries.name: Tiltster
entries.short: Tiltster's back has opened into a whole pinball table under glass, with lights, bumpers and a pair of flipper claws.

d.lore: Quivertoad, art-lane design.

entries.entry: Quivertoad, art-lane design.
entries.lore: Quivertoad carries a quiver of arrows on its back and wears red target rings on its hide, as a warning rather than an invitation. It tips each arrow with its own poison. Islanders who find a stray arrow in a fence post leave it exactly where it is.
entries.name: Quivertoad
entries.short: Quivertoad carries a quiver of arrows on its back and wears red target rings on its hide, as a warning rather than an invitation.

d.lore: Citadoad, art-lane design.

entries.entry: Citadoad, art-lane design.
entries.lore: Citadoad is a horned toad as broad as a cart, its back a fortress of spiked plates and its tail a heavy mace. It never hurries, since nothing has ever made it. Smaller Boki shelter in its shadow when hawks circle.
entries.name: Citadoad
entries.short: Citadoad is a horned toad as broad as a cart, its back a fortress of spiked plates and its tail a heavy mace.

d.lore: Pre-evolution of Jerbolt.

entries.entry: Pre-evolution of Jerbolt.
entries.lore: Jerbit bounces everywhere on a tail coiled like a spring, with a tuft at the tip that crackles as it lands. The tiny jerboa cannot sit still for longer than a blink. It naps mid-hop and wakes up somewhere else.
entries.name: Jerbit
entries.short: Jerbit bounces everywhere on a tail coiled like a spring, with a tuft at the tip that crackles as it lands.

d.lore: Evolution of Jerbit.

entries.entry: Evolution of Jerbit.
entries.lore: Jerbolt has springs wound round both ankles and a mane that stands on end with static. Each leap charges it a little more, so by evening it glows faintly and its fur snaps at anything it brushes. It grew from Jerbit and has still not learned to sit still.
entries.name: Jerbolt
entries.short: Jerbolt has springs wound round both ankles and a mane that stands on end with static.

d.lore: Evolution of Jerbolt.

entries.entry: Evolution of Jerbolt.
entries.lore: Copper fins have risen along Dynaboa's back, and they hum as it runs. Every bound stores up a charge that it lets go from its tail tuft in one bright crack. Islanders string lanterns near its favourite track, and they flicker on when it passes.
entries.name: Dynaboa
entries.short: Copper fins have risen along Dynaboa's back, and they hum as it runs.

d.lore: Bastling, art-lane design.

entries.entry: Bastling, art-lane design.
entries.lore: Bastling is a small rock crab with a sprig of coral and a tuft of seaweed rooted on its shell. It waves its one big claw at everything it meets, friend or not. When it is frightened it tucks its legs in and passes for a pebble on the beach.
entries.name: Bastling
entries.short: Bastling is a small rock crab with a sprig of coral and a tuft of seaweed rooted on its shell.

abilities.text: Cairnback heaves a rune-lit boulder 8m. Where it lands everyone within 2.6m is thrown up and stunned; anyone already airborne is spiked.

abilities.name: Mass Guard
abilities.text: When you're under fire, Cairnback curls into a heavy plate in front of you for 3s that stops enemy shots (120 HP).

abilities.name: Cairn Colossus
abilities.text: Cairnback rises into a rune-carved colossus under you for 8s: a stone shell takes the hits first, and every stomp quakes the ground and stuns.

d.lore: A tortoise with an ibex's sweeping horns, carrying a little rune-carved cairn on its shell. Hatched from the Stone Colossus's egg.
d.quirk: Adds one pebble to its cairn for every expedition it comes home from.
d.sexNote: Cool eggs hatch male, warm hatch female

temper.play: A wall of stone. Heaves boulders that quake and stun.

d.voice: ancient and calm, speaks slowly like grinding stone, fiercely protective

entries.name: Cairnback
entries.short: Cairnback never lives in the wild; it hatches only from the Rare Egg of the Stone Colossus.

abilities.name: Hive Crown
abilities.text: Hivara crowns you with its hive for 7s: 20% more damage, and every shot stings, poisons and slows.

d.lore: A honeybee with a praying mantis's folded blades, wearing a crown of wax. A swarm of tiny bees follows it everywhere. Hatched from the Brood Mother's egg.
d.quirk: Its swarm leaves wax drops wherever honey is stored; follow them.
d.sexNote: Only female; the swarm is her daughters

d.voice: busy and bossy, always organising, hums when it's happy

entries.lore: A honeybee with a mantis's folded blades, armoured in plates of honeycomb wax. The swarm of tiny bees that follows Hivara everywhere is her daughters. Hivara hatches only from a Rare Egg taken from the Brood.
entries.name: Hivara
entries.short: A honeybee with a mantis's folded blades, armoured in plates of honeycomb wax.

abilities.name: Storm Arc

abilities.name: Stormwing
abilities.text: Zephyrak wraps you in a living storm for 10s. Chaining bolts, a hover over any gap, a double storm blink, and Fuse again calls a thunderhead down on everyone near.

d.lore: A little sky serpent: a moray eel's long body with a swift's swept wings, crackling with static. Hatched from Stormcoil's egg.
d.quirk: Static builds in its scales overnight; it shocks whoever touches it first each morning.

temper.name: Wild
temper.play: Fast and electric. Spears through foes and arcs lightning.

d.voice: wild and quick, crackles with excitement, loves heights and speed

entries.entry: A little sky serpent: a moray eel's long body with a swift's swept wings, crackling with static. Hatched from Stormcoil's egg.
entries.habitat: Never in the wild. It only hatches from a Rare Egg won from Serpent.
entries.lore: Zephyrak hatches only from Stormcoil's egg. The little sky serpent has a moray's long body and a swift's swept wings, and static builds in its scales overnight, so whoever touches it first each morning gets a shock.
entries.name: Zephyrak
entries.short: Zephyrak hatches only from Stormcoil's egg.

d.lore: A peacock whose eye-spots are glass evil-eye charms.

entries.entry: A peacock whose eye-spots are glass evil-eye charms.
entries.lore: Every eye-spot on Pavonazar's train is a glass charm that stares down bad luck. Islanders say a house it has walked past will have no trouble until the next new moon. Males are deep blue with bright blue charms; females are green, with a shorter train and amber charms.
entries.name: Pavonazar
entries.short: Every eye-spot on Pavonazar's train is a glass charm that stares down bad luck.

d.lore: A vampire squid that is a fortune-teller's crystal ball.

entries.entry: A vampire squid that is a fortune-teller's crystal ball.
entries.lore: Ghoulamari's head is a fortune-teller's crystal ball with pale mist turning inside it. Its arms trail off into smoke, and it drifts up from deep water on moonless nights. Those who look into the glass see something true, though rarely what they asked about.
entries.name: Ghoulamari
entries.short: Ghoulamari's head is a fortune-teller's crystal ball with pale mist turning inside it.

d.lore: Wayshell, art-lane design.

entries.entry: Wayshell, art-lane design.
entries.lore: Wayshell's shell is a great brass compass, and star patterns are scattered across its flippers. The needle does not point north; it points to wherever the turtle means to go next. Lost sailors who follow one always reach a shore, though not always the one they wanted.
entries.name: Wayshell
entries.short: Wayshell's shell is a great brass compass, and star patterns are scattered across its flippers.

d.lore: A sea angel that is a frosty shuttlecock.

entries.entry: A sea angel that is a frosty shuttlecock.
entries.lore: Clionice drifts beneath the winter ice like a small pale angel, its wings feathered with frost. A crescent of moonlight glows on its belly, bright enough to see through the ice from above. Fishers who spot the glow leave that hole alone for the night.
entries.name: Clionice
entries.short: Clionice drifts beneath the winter ice like a small pale angel, its wings feathered with frost.

entries.entry: A mammoth carved from one colossal block of glacier ice, like a banquet ice sculpture come alive.
entries.lore: Glaciammoth looks carved from one colossal block of glacier ice, a banquet ice sculpture come to life, with a single great horn curved like a blade. On warm days it stands in the shade, fretting about its chisel lines.
entries.name: Glaciammoth
entries.short: Glaciammoth looks carved from one colossal block of glacier ice, a banquet ice sculpture come to life, with a single great horn curved like a blade.

d.lore: A cobra whose hood spreads into the great gold-and-lapis wings carved on royal coffin lids.

entries.entry: A cobra whose hood spreads into the great gold-and-lapis wings carved on royal coffin lids.
entries.lore: A cobra whose hood spreads into great wings of gold and lapis, like those carved on royal coffin lids. Sarcobra guards old tombs and ruins and only spreads its hood fully when something comes too close.
entries.name: Sarcobra
entries.short: A cobra whose hood spreads into great wings of gold and lapis, like those carved on royal coffin lids.

d.lore: Siegephant, art-lane design.

entries.entry: Siegephant, art-lane design.
entries.lore: A ruined castle stands on Siegephant's back, moss on the walls and the gate still shut. Its trunk is bound in chain and stone, and it swings like a battering ram. Old walls across the islands have gaps exactly its size.
entries.name: Siegephant
entries.short: A ruined castle stands on Siegephant's back, moss on the walls and the gate still shut.

entries.entry: Aurostag, art-lane design.
entries.lore: Aurostag's antlers are branches of northern light, green fading to violet, and the same glow runs in ribbons down its dark coat. Frost crystals grow wherever its hooves rest. On the longest nights it walks the sky, and islanders stay up to watch the colours follow it.

d.lore: A blue whale that is a cathedral pipe organ.

entries.entry: A blue whale that is a cathedral pipe organ.
entries.lore: Organwhal is a great whale with organ pipes rising from its back and running along its belly. When it sings, every pipe sounds at once, and the note is felt in the chest before it is heard. Whole villages have stopped work to listen until it passed.

d.lore: Cindermaw, art-lane design.

entries.entry: Cindermaw, art-lane design.
entries.lore: Cindermaw wears a bare skull for a face and a mane of black smoke that never clears. Embers burn behind its ribs where the blight has eaten through, and the ground it crosses is left scorched. Other Boki go silent long before it comes into view.

d.lore: Enigmane, art-lane design.

entries.entry: Enigmane, art-lane design.
entries.lore: Enigmane is a winged lion split by glowing violet cracks, with bone spurs pushing through its dark hide. It sits across old roads and asks a question of everyone who passes. No two travellers agree on what it asked, only that they answered wrong.
